verdict.rationale: Treg keeps provider keys out of the agent's hands: it injects credentials server-side, and the Claude connector authenticates via OAuth with PKCE rather than pasted tokens. Admins can also restrict which tools each team member may use and whether they may run CLIs locally. However, these restrictions are scoped to team members, not to agent-specific credentials, and the agent otherwise holds a single treg token. missing for 10: per-agent or per-token scope definitions, token expiry/rotation/revocation controls, read-only or endpoint-level permission granularity, independent corroboration.
